def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    result = [0] * len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return result

    ranks = {value: i + 1 for i, value in enumerate(sorted(set(a)))}
    size = len(ranks)
    bit = [0] * (size + 1)

    for i, height in enumerate(a):
        rank = ranks[height]

        # Count previous window heights less than or equal to this height.
        count = 0
        j = rank
        while j > 0:
            count += bit[j]
            j -= j & -j
        result[i] = min(i, k) - count

        # Insert the current height.
        j = rank
        while j <= size:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

        # Keep only the last k heights for the next position.
        if i >= k:
            j = ranks[a[i - k]]
            while j <= size:
                bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & -j

    return result
